title: Phase 68 defines eight outcome-cohort admission contracts without manufacturing a trend
summary: An eight-file public registry now tests sixty-four compatibility fields and defines thirty-two future measure families. All eight cohorts remain in Acquisition with zero observation values, series points, scores, rankings, or outcome claims.
evidence_note: Phase 68 publishes an admission method and empty candidate-series contracts. It does not represent a source check, returned artifact, accepted series, observation value, trend, outcome, comparison, or causal result.
publication_effect: Adds one Published briefing, one Published dependency map, one public registry export, and reader-surface integrations while leaving every Phase 64, Phase 67, signal, receipt, and outcome state unchanged.
